q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of an office chair?
title: Office chair carbon footprint per chair
short: Add the base, gas lift, mechanism, seat shell, foam, fabric and castors per chair with supplier figures. Add moulding, upholstery and assembly energy, then divide the plant's energy by chairs made.
audience: Office chair makers and furniture buyers

ul: Nylon or aluminium base and castors.
Plastic shell, foam and fabric or mesh.
Moulding of plastic parts if done in-house.

p: Report per chair by model and weight. An aluminium base carries more footprint than a nylon one.

example.title: Worked example: office chair unit per chair (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 10,000 = 1.420 kg CO2 per chair
Add base, mechanism, foam and fabric for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
